title: Liberal Arts and Sciences Native American Studies

program.section_heading: LIBERAL ARTS AND SCIENCES WITH AN EMPHASIS IN NATIVE AMERICAN STUDIES ASSOCIATE OF ARTS
outcomes: Identify and explain the culture and history of a variety of Indigenous tribes including the connections between Native American history and the contemporary state of Native America.
Explain the historical and contemporary relationship between the U.S. Government, state and local governments and "domestic dependent sovereign nations."
Explain the role of tribal government structures and the impact of tribal regulations on tribal members and families.
Evaluate how struggle, resistance, adaptation, solidarity, and liberation as experienced by Native Americans informs current Native American experience.
